title: Sheet Pan Potato, Lentil & Crispy Kale Bowl with Grilled Chicken
description: Roasted potatoes, crisped lentils, and charred kale on a sheet pan, topped with grilled chicken and a Greek yogurt tahini sauce. High fiber, high protein.
